subject: Practitioner Residency — SI enablement kickoff & lab access
messages:
From: Asha Menon <asha.menon@epsiloncons.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Cc: ops@epsiloncons.com
Date: 2027-05-19T08:12:00-07:00
Subject: Practitioner Residency proposal — initial request

Hi Jonas,

Thanks again for the demo last week. We had a productive internal discussion and would like to scope a short 'Practitioner Residency' for our consulting team — 3 weeks of shadowing, hands-on labs, and a joint customer-facing capstone. The goals are:
- Make 6 consultants able to independently run Redwood Dedicated demos and run a basic integration by the end of the residency.
- Transfer runbook knowledge for deployment patterns and troubleshooting common latency/cost issues.
- Produce an internal enablement playbook and a customer-facing starter template.

High-level asks from our side:
1) Can Redwood provide an enablement outline and preferred VM/instance specs for the lab?
2) We need SOC2 artifact references and any relevant security onboarding checklists for our procurement team.
3) Do you have a recommended week-by-week agenda (shadow, lab, capstone)?

We'd like to run the residency the week of June 14 if that works on your side. Ops (cc'd) will handle logistics; I can loop in procurement for PO steps after we align scope.

Cheers,
Asha Menon
Head of Integrations | Epsilon Consulting
Asha.menon@epsiloncons.com

Attachment: none on this message
From: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
To: Asha Menon <asha.menon@epsiloncons.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, sean_gallagher@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-05-19T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Practitioner Residency proposal — initial request

Thanks Asha — excited to run this with Epsilon. Quick answers and next steps below.

Agenda / week-by-week (draft):
Week 0 - Prep & access: account provisioning, brief on model choices, security overview.
Week 1 - Shadow: pair with Redwood engineers on live demos and observability walkthroughs.
Week 2 - Labs: hands-on labs (deploy a model, tune batching/caching, cost regressions).
Week 3 - Capstone: joint run with a sample customer scenario and creation of an SI starter repo.

Lab environment / VM guidance:
- We can provide pre-baked sandbox snapshots on our Dedicated pool. For 6 consultants running concurrent labs we recommend: 2 x p4d.24xlarge-equivalent nodes (burstable) and single smaller GPU node for latency experiments.
- If Epsilon wants to self-host on cloud, minimum: 1 x A100-40GB for the main lab + 1 x T4 for scaled tests.

Security / procurement artifacts:
- I'll attach a short residency-outline and a scoping-sheet for your procurement. For SOC 2 artifacts we have a standard pack; procurement can request via our security portal (link below).

Logistics + dates:
- Proposed start: week of 2027-06-14. We can compress to two weeks if you prefer an intensive cohort.
- Please confirm cohort size (you mentioned ~6) and target time zone / daily windows for labs.

Next steps:
1) Asha: confirm cohort size and whether Epsilon wants Redwood-hosted sandboxes.
2) Ops: share procurement contact / PO cadence (cc'ed).
3) Marissa & Sean: I'll need a quick ops checklist and lab access requirements (see cc).

I'll attach the residency-outline and scoping-sheet now.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Partner Lead | Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.ai

Attachments: residency-outline.pdf, scoping-sheet.xlsx
Links: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0B-residency-kickoff
From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: jonas_weber@redwood.ai, Asha Menon <asha.menon@epsiloncons.com>
Cc: sean_gallagher@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-05-19T11:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Practitioner Residency proposal — initial request

Looping in operational details and a practical checklist from enablement.

Marissa's enablement checklist (concise):
- Confirm: cohort size = 6 (please reconfirm).
- Required artifact list for each attendee: corporate email, GitHub access (or provisioned repo), acceptance of our lab terms.
- Lab access: ops will need full names, emails, and manager approvals 5 business days before start.
- Environment snapshot: we'll provision a sandbox image with preloaded example prompts, a small demo corpus, and an NGINX ingress to simulate customer traffic.
- VM sizing: see Jonas' guidance; we'll default to Redwood-hosted sandboxes unless you prefer cloud-hosted.
- Trainer roster: Marissa (lead trainer), 1 engineer for observability (Sean), 1 engineer for deployment/QoS (TBD).

I've attached a brief "lab-access-reqs.docx" that lists user provisioning steps and a minimal playbook for resetting environments between cohorts. Sean, can you confirm session length recommendations (2.5 hours/day interactive + 1 hour async)?

Asha — if procurement needs an SOW draft we can produce a short SOW that maps to the three-week schedule + deliverables (playbook + starter repo). Indicate if you'd prefer an SOW or statement of work template.

Thanks — Marissa
Marissa Cole
Solutions Enablement Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

Attachment: lab-access-reqs.docx
From: Asha Menon <asha.menon@epsiloncons.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: ops@epsiloncons.com
Date: 2027-05-21T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Practitioner Residency proposal — initial request

Thanks Jonas and Marissa — this looks good. Confirming cohort size: 6 consultants. Redwood-hosted sandboxes preferred to avoid cloud admin overhead on our side.

Procurement note from ops: please send a short SOW + invoice instructions. Our procurement team needs the following to issue a PO: line-item SOW, Redwood tax ID, estimated total (we expect this to be a fixed-fee engagement). We also need the SOC 2 summary and encryption-at-rest statement for our security team; if you have a standard security pack link that would accelerate review.

Start date: June 14 works for us. One ask on the capstone — can we include a short customer scenario that focuses on cost optimization and fallback routing? That will be high value operationally.

I'll share the attendee list and corporate emails by next Wednesday.

Best,
Asha
Head of Integrations | Epsilon Consulting
Asha.menon@epsiloncons.com
